name: Amuse 4.0 (free open-source local AI studio: image, video, music, speech)
summary: Windows desktop app that runs open generative models on your own GPU (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel): text/image-to-image and inpainting (FLUX.2 Klein, Qwen Image...), text/image-to-video with long chunked clips (LTX-2.x, Wan 2.2, HunyuanVideo 1.5), music (ACE-Step 1.5, Stable Audio 3), TTS and voice cloning, sound effects, transcription and local chat. v4.0.0 adds the audio and language backends. No account, no credits; models download from Hugging Face in Q4/Q8/full precision.

access.license: Apache-2.0 (app); each model under its own license
access.notes: App is Apache-2.0; commercial use of outputs depends on each downloaded model's license. Windows 10/11 64-bit only; GPU needed (bigger video models need much more VRAM). Models are downloaded separately.

procedure: Open https://www.amuse-ai.com/ and click Download for Windows (or grab Amuse_v4.0.0.exe / .zip from the GitHub v4.0.0 release)
Run the ~420 MB installer on Windows 10/11 64-bit
On first start Amuse picks the backend for your GPU
Open the model manager, download a model at Q4, Q8 or full precision (check its license), then generate

stats.count: image, video, audio and text studios

verdict.why: Fresh major release (v4.0.0, Nov 27) of a free Apache-2.0 app that bundles image, video, music, TTS and SFX generation locally with no account or credits, on AMD/Intel as well as NVIDIA. Limits: Windows only, needs a capable GPU, and output rights depend on each model's own license.
